sections.heading: Browse Tab
sections.content:
The Browse tab gives users access totyDiffusion’s natively-supported model library.

The model library features a hand-picked selection of diffusion models, ControlNet models, LoRAs, etc. If you would like to use a model that is not available in the model library, it can still be used bytyDiffusion(as long as it isSD 1.5orSD XLcompatible) - simply place it in the proper model folder (as defined in: ‘Setup tab’ > ‘Paths tab’).

All models in thetyDiffusionmodel library (as well as their corresponding license text) can be found in thetyDiffusion HuggingFace repo

sections.heading: Queue tab
sections.content:
The Queue tab displays queued/downloading/completed/errored items in the download queue. You can modify the queue from the [>>] menu.

Please see theAI FAQpage, for information about troubleshooting downloads.
